description: Source documents of a company's latest snapshot: kind, period, release or filing date (indexed: the date an index added a report that states no date of publication), URL of the official document or of the search page of its store, and SHA-256 of the file used. Pass the document ids found in a statement's sources to resolve them.

at.description: an ISO date: the snapshot that was the latest on that date, in place of the latest snapshot

company.description: company id from search_companies, for example apple or mizuho

ids.description: document ids, for example ["10-K:0000320193-25-000079"]; leave empty for all

name: get_sources
title: Get source documents
